description: Witness is a warehouse supervisor at Coastline Moving Company
Started as a loader in March 2016, promoted to supervisor in 2018
Worked the day shift 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. on October 14, 2024
Was near Loading Dock 4 at about 2:15 p.m.
Rivera slipped on a wet patch near a pallet jack and fell on his right side
Wet patch was about three feet across
No wet floor sign was near the patch
Walked through the aisle at about 1:00 p.m. and noticed nothing
Called first aid on the radio; attendant arrived about four minutes later
Rivera said his hip hurt badly and he could not stand
Witness filled out the incident report that evening and gave it to Tom Becker
Took three photographs before the area was cleaned
Since November 2024 supervisors sign an aisle inspection log every two hours
Thinks the cleaning crew member was Luis Ortega but is not certain
